news.label: Claude Fable 5.2 Announced
points: Designs board, case, and firmware end to end
Worked with no electrical design changes
details: Claude handled everything from choosing electronic parts and routing a four layer PCB to the CAD design of a 3D printed case and writing the software.
The three prototypes are a voice assistant, a USB speakerphone, and a handheld virtual pet. Manufacturing and assembly were done with help from companies.
This is the result of pre-testing by the manufacturers, and it doesn't mean any circuit can go into mass production unverified.

lines.say: The A I designed everything from the circuit board to the case and the firmware, and three prototypes were built from it.
lines.show: The AI designed the board, case, and firmware, and three prototypes were built.

news.label: MIT WorldParticle
points: One AI for sand, liquids, and more
Handles six kinds of physical phenomena
details: It represents materials as collections of 3D particles and uses a Transformer to predict how each particle moves next.
Fluids, sand, deformable bodies, proteins, and more used to need separate solvers, but now one shared architecture handles them all.
The speedup is the research team's report, compared with conventional numerical simulation. For now, this is a research result.

news.label: MIT and NYU: FLEX Robot
points: Protect the laptop, avoid the phone too
details: From natural language cautions, it infers intentions people never stated and revises its action plan.
Given the instruction not to spill coffee on the laptop, it changes its path to avoid a nearby smartphone as well.
It updates its judgment in three steps: Add, Generalize, and Mask. Evaluation was in simulation, and real robot tests are still to come.

news.label: Canon MREAL Collaborator
details: It supports OpenXR, so people in different places can share life size 3DCG across multiple XR devices.
The public can try it for the first time at Sangyo Koryu Ten 2026, held November 11 to 13.
It focuses on an intuitive interface, making it easy to join design reviews.

news.label: Fabric Formwork Saves Material
details: Topology optimized concrete beams with complex shapes are cast in formwork made of cut and sewn fabric.
In a test beam about three meters long, concrete use was about one third and rebar about half of a conventional design.
Relatively inexpensive fabric molds make it possible without 3D printers or CNC machines. For now, these are research test pieces.
